tv:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: reusable decorative frame for one animated GitHub README storyboard, landscape 1536 x 1024.
Primary request: a beautiful old 1970s countertop color television, straight-on front view, isolated on a plain warm ivory background. The entire television is visible with small breathing room. Walnut veneer cabinet, rounded dark brown edges, thick charcoal screen bezel, two large tactile tuning dials on the RIGHT, small speaker grille, little feet. Authentic worn-in kitchen appliance, sophisticated hand-painted editorial illustration, limited warm muted colors, paper texture, terracotta and sage accents. No futuristic elements.
Composition: television fills 94 percent of image width and 88 percent of height. A VERY LARGE BLANK FLAT dark charcoal display occupies the LEFT 76 percent of the television. Display is a simple rounded rectangle with minimal curvature, absolutely front-on, with no reflections, no image, no objects inside it. Keep the actual screen an unbroken solid near-black fill so animation can be composited inside. The side dials and speaker occupy the narrow right 17 percent. No antenna extending outside canvas.
Text: no text, no logo, no words, no watermark. Keep the scene simple and highly legible at 900px wide.
scenes:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: SIX storyboard animation scene illustrations on ONE exact evenly divided contact sheet, landscape 1536 x 1024.
Primary request: tell the Scratch Kitchen story through six cozy human scenes. SIX equal square panels arranged EXACTLY THREE columns by TWO rows, edge-to-edge, no gaps, no borders, no gutters, no typography. Each panel occupies exactly one sixth of the canvas. No television, no frames. All six scenes have the same hand-painted mid-century editorial illustration style, warm ivory paper, muted walnut brown, terracotta, ochre, sage green, appealing kitchen details. Same protagonist throughout: adult home cook with short dark wavy hair, terracotta shirt and sage green apron.
Panel 1 TOP LEFT: cook holding a phone, recording inside an open home refrigerator with cooked chicken in a lidded glass container, carrots, celery and a jar of stock. Phone clearly pointed into fridge.
Panel 2 TOP MIDDLE: cook at kitchen counter reviewing the same ingredients laid out beside a phone with a simple inventory list of colored rows and a small chicken thumbnail; abstract colored shapes only, no words or numbers.
Panel 3 TOP RIGHT: cook and another adult sitting at a small kitchen table, enjoying modest plates of roast chicken and vegetables; warm evening kitchen. Main point: a fresh meal from ingredients on hand.
Panel 4 BOTTOM LEFT: next meal in same kitchen, cook ladling steaming chicken-and-vegetable soup from a pot into a bowl; remaining roasted chicken being transformed into soup, carrots and celery visible on board. Main point: new meal, not same dinner repeated.
Panel 5 BOTTOM MIDDLE: cook carefully packing an extra portion of soup into a clean lidded container, adding a BLANK cream label with tiny abstract colored marks, checking a simple tick box on a phone beside it. Main point: label and personally approve this batch.
Panel 6 BOTTOM RIGHT: cook at front door handing the labeled closed food container directly to a friendly adult neighbor, warm appreciative human interaction, no vehicles, no delivery uniforms, no money. Main point: a human-coordinated free share.
Constraints: no legible text whatsoever, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermarks, no labels saying safe or certified, no autonomous delivery, no payment icons. All scenes clear through action. Frame important action in middle area of each square with enough room to crop top and bottom to a landscape image. Characters maintain same appearance across panels. Scenes should feel specific, warm and practical, not generic tech marketing.
